title: Morning Brief, Sun 15 Nov 2026: IMD says the southeast Bay of Bengal low became a well-marked low on 14 Nov and is likely to become a depression within 24 h, a cyclonic storm around 16 Nov evening and a severe cyclonic storm by 18 Nov; no landfall named, IMD Amaravati says most models point to the AP coast; very heavy rain coastal AP 19 Nov, Odisha 19-20 Nov, squalls gusting to 70 km/h; fishermen to return by 15 Nov; would be the third cyclonic storm after Arnab and Murasu (lead); Pakistan nominates Climate Change Minister Musadik Masood Malik for the SCO Civilisational Dialogue in New Delhi, 20-22 Nov, first Pakistani minister in India since May 2023; Jaishankar (HTLS, 14 Nov) says India-US trade deal 'almost at the finishing line', bulk of issues sorted, remaining concerns 'not so much at our end', no timeframe; Modi expected to meet Trump in Manila around the 16-17 Nov ASEAN summits (IE; Quad summit 17 Nov per sources, The Hindu); India U19 beat Pakistan by one wicket (last-ball four by Mohit Ulva, chasing 338) for a ninth U19 Asia Cup title, Al Amerat, Oman, 14 Nov; Zelensky says US negotiators raised Ukraine leaving Donbas in exchange for NATO membership, first time raised, would put a concrete offer to a referendum, US has not confirmed
headline: IMD: Severe Cyclonic Storm Likely in Bay by 18 Nov
